name: US support specialist seeking written-channel remote work

constraints: Email/chat support rather than phone sales
context.company_awareness: Few named targets; needs employer discovery

trigger: Repeated searches for chat support lead to mixed phone roles and generic apply pages, so the candidate starts checking employer identity and shift details before proceeding.

searches_run.query: remote customer support email chat jobs US no phone
searches_run.observation: Results included broad boards and numerous generic non-phone landing pages. An Indeed no-phone query page still contained phone duties; confident page titles did not establish job suitability.

searches_run.query: customer support specialist email chat remote United States shifts careers
searches_run.observation: The sample surfaced ClearLine's self-described careers page. Inspection showed phone/email/chat duties and nights/weekends/holidays language, but no exact individual shift schedule; it is a mismatch for written-only support.

sources.title: Email Chat Customer Service No Phones Remote jobs — Indeed
sources.supports: Retrieved page snippet contains phone/email/chat duties and variable shift-start descriptions despite the search-page label.

sources.title: Email Support Specialist [Non-Phone] — Remote Job Recruiting
sources.supports: Retrieved page advertises non-phone work for an unnamed subscription company. Used only as evidence of retrieval presentation, not as a verified employer or vacancy.

sources.title: Careers — ClearLine CX
sources.supports: Directly inspected self-published page advertises US remote roles but explicitly includes phone support and broad round-the-clock coverage. Employer legitimacy and individual vacancies were not independently verified.

best_entry_page.primary_query: remote email chat customer support jobs US
best_entry_page.promise: Find covered employers' support postings and inspect stated channels, location restrictions and shifts before applying.
best_entry_page.cta: Try free support searches, open the source posting and save alerts for relevant employers.
proof_needed: Show named employers and traceable source postings; do not badge them as verified safe.
Prove US support-employer coverage before making this a priority SEO landing.
Separate email/chat-only from mixed-channel work and sales.
Show exact shift text, timezone and unknown schedules.
Explain free search/alerts and optional paid description checks.
New indexable page required; filtered search is currently noindex.

conversion_objections: Is this another page that sends me to an unnamed employer?
Will no-phone searches still include outbound sales?
Are jobs available in my state?
What hours would I actually work?
Can I use the useful parts without paying?
Do you verify companies, or only collect their descriptions?

avoid_targeting.query: verified scam free remote jobs guaranteed
avoid_targeting.reason: Employer verification and guarantees are not demonstrated.

avoid_targeting.query: no experience chat jobs 35 dollars guaranteed

message_to_founder: Simulation: I need an actual employer, a written-support role and a schedule I can evaluate. Free alerts could help, but I would leave if I still had to open every result to discover it is phone sales or an unspecified shift.
confidence_and_limits: Synthetic candidate. Two queries and one direct inspection; no fraud accusation or employer endorsement made. The noisy retrieved sample does not quantify demand or prove all non-phone listings unreliable. State restrictions and exact availability remain unspecified.
